stories.title: CFMoto abre novo lote com 700 motos no Brasil; veja preços e data

en.title: CFMoto opens new batch with 700 motorcycles in Brazil; see prices and date
en.summary: CFMoto made available a new batch of 700 motorcycles for the Brazilian market.

stories.title: Domingo Aéreo: AFA abre 1º lote com 20 mil ingressos gratuitos no interior de SP; veja como reservar

en.title: Aerial Sunday: AFA opens 1st batch with 20 thousand free tickets in interior SP; see how to book
en.summary: The Air Force Academy opened registration for 20,000 free tickets to the Aerial Sunday event in Pirassununga, scheduled for November 1st.

stories.title: Casal suspeito de matar americano no Paraná usou dinheiro da vítima para fazer compras: 'Só em dois relógios, R$ 10 mil', diz delegado

en.title: Couple suspected of killing American in Paraná used victim's money to make purchases: 'Just in two watches, R$ 10 thousand', says delegate
en.summary: A couple is being investigated for the death of an American in Maringá and allegedly spent over 10,000 reais of the victim's money on personal purchases.

stories.title: Suprema Corte dos EUA autoriza governo Trump a retomar checagem de cidadania de eleitores

en.title: US Supreme Court authorizes Trump government to resume checking citizenship of voters
en.summary: The US Supreme Court authorized the Trump administration to verify voter citizenship using federal databases with social security numbers and other information.

stories.title: Tenente da Marinha é encontrada morta na USP

en.title: Navy Lieutenant found dead at USP
en.summary: A 33-year-old Brazilian Navy officer was discovered dead at the University of São Paulo on Thursday afternoon. Federal Police and the Navy are investigating the death of the officer who worked at a naval technology center located on the university campus.

stories.title: Lula reforça críticas às bets, na mira do governo: 'Não é correto gastar o que não tem pra tentar ganhar o que não existe'

en.title: Lula reinforces criticism of betting apps, targeting government: 'It is not right to spend what you don't have to try to win what doesn't exist'
en.summary: President Lula criticized online betting during a campaign event in Pernambuco on Friday. He argued that money spent on betting should instead be used for essential family needs like food.

stories.title: Lula anuncia fim de bets ‘para proteger famílias’ após governo regular apostas como solução a ‘caos’

en.title: Lula announces end of betting apps 'to protect families' after government regulates betting as solution to 'chaos'
en.summary: President Lula announced measures to end betting apps to protect families, following government regulation of betting activities.

stories.title: Descarga elétrica mata dois homens e fere outros dois em obra de casa em Santo André, na Grande SP

en.title: Electric discharge kills two men and injures two others during house renovation in Santo André, in Greater São Paulo
en.summary: Two men died from an electrical shock during a house renovation in Santo André on Friday. Two other workers were also injured in the incident.

stories.title: Governo Lula reserva R$ 800 milhões no orçamento para reajustar bolsa de residentes médicos e multiprofissionais

en.title: Lula Government allocates R$ 800 million in budget to adjust medical resident and multiprofessional fellowships
en.summary: The Health Ministry will allocate over R$ 800 million in the 2027 budget to increase stipends paid to healthcare residents across different specialties.

stories.title: Operação sobre plano do PCC para matar promotor prende mais um suspeito em Campinas

en.title: Operation on PCC plan to kill prosecutor arrests another suspect in Campinas
en.summary: A suspect was arrested in Campinas as part of an operation investigating an alleged plan linked to organized crime figures to kill a prosecutor from the organized crime task force.

stories.title: Anvisa proíbe propaganda da caneta de semaglutida Semavy após anúncios irregulares

en.title: Anvisa prohibits advertising of semaglutide pen Semavy after irregular advertisements
en.summary: Brazil's health authority has banned advertising for a semaglutide pen product due to violations in how the product was being promoted.

stories.title: Engenheira da Marinha é encontrada morta em alojamento e levada a hospital antes de perícia, diz polícia

en.title: Navy engineer found dead in barracks and taken to hospital before examination, police say
en.summary: A 33-year-old Navy engineer was found dead in military housing at a university campus; authorities removed and transported the body to a hospital before an investigation could be conducted on site.

stories.title: Carrefour acerta venda de 21 lojas ao grupo Pereira por R$ 360 mi

en.title: Carrefour agrees to sell 21 stores to Pereira group for R$ 360 million
en.summary: Carrefour and the Pereira group have filed an agreement with Brazil's competition authority for the sale of 21 stores located in São Paulo and the Federal District.

stories.title: Turquia e Paquistão se unem em apoio à Arábia Saudita contra ataques dos houthis

en.title: Turkey and Pakistan unite in support of Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks
en.summary: Military leaders from Turkey and Pakistan discussed ways to support Saudi Arabia as Houthi militias intensify attacks on the kingdom and disrupt global oil flows during the broader Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Ibovespa cai e dólar tem leve alta com exterior no foco, após IPCA-15 'salgado'

en.title: Ibovespa falls and dollar rises slightly with focus on external markets, after higher-than-expected IPCA-15
en.summary: Brazil's stock exchange declined amid elevated inflation data and upcoming elections, while the dollar strengthened slightly as global markets and bond yields shifted.

stories.title: Análise: Queda livre dos títulos japoneses freia corrida por repatriação de recursos

en.title: Analysis: Sharp decline in Japanese bond yields curbs rush to repatriate funds
en.summary: Uncertainty about when Japanese bond yields will peak and how much further interest rates may rise is restraining a larger repatriation of capital held overseas by Japanese investors.

stories.title: MGM discute oferta pela People Inc, de Barry Diller, diz jornal

en.title: MGM discusses offer for People Inc, owned by Barry Diller, reports newspaper
en.summary: MGM Resorts International is considering making an offer to acquire People Inc, owned by Barry Diller, according to the Wall Street Journal. This comes one day after People Inc withdrew its own proposal to acquire MGM Resorts.
